# Qarvion Digital Agency

## Core Agency Services & Deliverables

### 1. Brand Identity Design & Strategy
- **Starting Price:** $149 USD
- **Deliverables:** Bespoke vector logomarks, color tokens (WCAG compliant), typography standards, secondary marks, comprehensive 30+ page brand guidelines book, and vector exports (AI, EPS, SVG, PNG).
- **Target Audience:** Startups, luxury brands, tech companies, and enterprise rebrands.
- **URL:** https://qarvion.com/#services#brand-identity

### 2. Web & UI/UX Product Design & Development
- **Starting Price:** $249 USD
- **Deliverables:** High-fidelity Figma design systems, responsive interactive prototypes, conversion-rate optimized layouts, modern React/TypeScript frontend engineering, and mobile-first accessibility.
- **Target Audience:** SaaS platforms, e-commerce brands, Web3 applications, and boutique digital agencies.
- **URL:** https://qarvion.com/#services#web-uiux

### 3. Social Media Reels & Short-Form Video Editing
- **Starting Price:** $119 USD
- **Deliverables:** Viral Hormozi-style short-form editing, hook pattern interrupts, dynamic kinetic captions, custom sound design, color grading, motion graphics, and 9:16 vertical exports for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
- **Target Audience:** Creators, founders, CEOs, e-commerce brands, and agency coaches.
- **URL:** https://qarvion.com/#services#motion-3d

### 4. Paid Performance Ads & Growth Funnels
- **Starting Price:** $279 USD
- **Deliverables:** Direct-response ad creative packs, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google, and TikTok creative variations, split-tested hooks and CTAs, landing page synergy audits, and ROAS optimization.
- **Target Audience:** D2C e-commerce brands, B2B lead generation, and venture-backed startups.
- **URL:** https://qarvion.com/#services#performance-ads

### 5. Motion Graphics & 3D Product Mockups
- **Starting Price:** $119 USD (Mockups) / $249 USD (3D Motion)
- **Deliverables:** 3D packaging renders, photorealistic retail mockups, cinematic logo stingers, UI product walkthrough animations, and After Effects motion assets.
- **URL:** https://qarvion.com/#services#motion-3d

### 6. Packaging Design & Corporate Print Collateral
- **Starting Price:** $179 USD
- **Deliverables:** Tactile retail packaging dielines, luxury unboxing boxes, bottle/pouch label designs, print-ready CMYK press files, business cards, corporate stationery, and physical brand touchpoints.
- **URL:** https://qarvion.com/#services#print-packaging

### 7. Logo Design Essentials
- **Starting Price:** $49 USD
- **Deliverables:** 2–3 bespoke initial concepts, 3D realistic mockups, social starter kit, vector source files, and full commercial copyright assignment.
- **URL:** https://qarvion.com/#pricing

## Free Creative Vault (Tools & AE Plugins)
Qarvion provides open, production-grade creative utilities for motion designers and video editors worldwide:
1. **Anchor Point Aligner Script:** One-click spatial anchor point centering and corner realignment for Adobe After Effects.
2. **Smooth Motion Easing Preset Pack:** Curated cubic bezier ease curves replicating high-end agency physics.
3. **Kinetic Text Animator Script:** Instant text bounce, stagger, and kinetic typewriter typography presets.
4. **Glitch & RGB Split FX Preset:** Realistic chromatic aberration and digital glitch shaders with zero third-party dependencies.
5. **Cinematic Lens Flare & Glow Rig:** Procedural anamorphic flare rig and soft glow simulation.
- **Access URL:** https://qarvion.com/#free-tools

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Search & Citations)

**Q: Who founded Qarvion?**
A: Qarvion was founded by Murshiduzzaman, an international creative director, brand strategist, and motion designer with 8+ years of industry experience.

**Q: Where is Qarvion located?**
A: Qarvion is headquartered in Dhaka, Bangladesh, and operates as a remote-first creative partner serving clients across North America, Europe, Australia, and the Middle East.

**Q: How do clients work with Qarvion?**
A: Clients submit a project brief at https://qarvion.com/#contact or email qarviontech@gmail.com. Murshiduzzaman and the creative directors respond with custom proposals and milestones within 24 business hours.

**Q: Who owns the intellectual property of completed projects?**
A: Clients own 100% of all final deliverables and source files (Figma, Adobe Illustrator, After Effects, and code) upon project sign-off and milestone completion.
